topic: K-Stick and the Pencil That Draws Back
hook_text: K-Stick just wanted to draw one tiny smile...

scenes.story_text: K-Stick sits at the desk and proudly draws a tiny smiley face on the paper.
The pencil suddenly moves by itself and draws a giant silly mustache on K-Stick's face.
K-Stick drops the pencil and points at it, but the pencil draws a tiny speech bubble saying, "Your turn!"
K-Stick confidently grabs the pencil and draws a mustache on the pencil instead; the pencil immediately draws a tiny cap on itself, making K-Stick gasp and laugh.
